summary: Tyre is the seaport ruled by Hiram. The wedding song speaks of the daughter of Tyre bringing a gift, and Ezekiel portrays the city trading with peoples on many coasts.

senses.definition: Hiram sends timber and craftsmen to David. Ezekiel addresses the city at the approaches to the sea, where ships exchange merchandise.
These people from Tyre bring fish and other merchandise into Jerusalem. A Tyrian craftsman makes the bronze furnishings for Solomon.

note: The city also appears as צוֹר. Ezekiel 26:4 compares its future site to bare rock. The similar word for rock is under tsur. The lexicon’s page grouping under צפר gives no explanation for the place-name.
